categories.main_business_segments: Jinko Solar Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the photovoltaic (PV) industry, focusing on the manufacturing and sales of solar products including monocrystalline silicon rods, silicon wafers, solar cells, and photovoltaic modules. The company also develops and sells energy storage solutions and photovoltaic building-integrated products (BIPV). It maintains a vertically integrated production chain from silicon wafer production to solar module assembly, serving global solar power plant investors, developers, contractors, and distributed PV system end customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced photovoltaic technologies such as N-type TOPCon solar cells, PERC, bifacial modules, half-cut cells, multi-busbar, and large-size wafer technologies. It employs vertical integration with in-house production of silicon wafers, cells, and modules, supported by automated, digitalized, and intelligent manufacturing processes. R&D focuses on improving efficiency, reducing costs, and innovating in areas like perovskite tandem cells, energy storage integration, and recycling of PV modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jinko Solar serves a diverse global customer base including ground-mounted solar power plant investors, developers, EPC contractors, distributors, and residential PV system users. Its products are sold in over 190 countries and regions, with significant market presence in China, Europe, the Americas, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and emerging markets. The company targets utility-scale, commercial, industrial, and residential solar markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with manufacturing facilities and sales networks spanning China, Southeast Asia (notably Malaysia and Vietnam), the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and other emerging markets. It has established overseas integrated production capacity exceeding 12GW and maintains a balanced global market presence to mitigate regional risks and capture growth opportunities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jinko Solar operates as a vertically integrated manufacturer covering upstream to downstream segments of the photovoltaic supply chain. It produces silicon wafers, solar cells, and modules, positioning itself as a midstream to downstream player with control over key production stages and supply chain resilience.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high R&D investment to maintain technological leadership, focusing on high-efficiency, low-cost, intelligent, and digitalized PV technologies. Key R&D directions include advancing N-type TOPCon cells, perovskite tandem cells, energy storage solutions, BIPV products, and sustainable recycling technologies. It also emphasizes global supply chain optimization, ESG compliance, and digital transformation to enhance operational efficiency and market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Jinko Solar generates revenue primarily through the sale of photovoltaic modules and related solar products. It operates a direct sales model for large-scale projects and an agency/distribution model for smaller commercial and residential customers. Additional revenue streams include energy storage system sales and related services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jinko Solar is a global leader in the photovoltaic industry, ranking first in global solar module shipments in 2023. It competes with other major PV manufacturers such as LONGi, Trina Solar, and Canadian Solar. The company differentiates itself through technological innovation, vertical integration, global supply chain presence, and strong brand recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Jinko Solar reported revenue of approximately RMB 118.7 billion, a 43.55% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 7.44 billion, up 153.2%. The company’s operating cash flow grew significantly by over 500%, reflecting strong sales growth and cash collection. It maintains substantial assets totaling over RMB 132 billion and continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinko Solar emphasizes delivering high-efficiency, reliable, and cost-effective photovoltaic products with advanced N-type TOPCon technology that offers superior conversion efficiency and durability. Its vertically integrated production and global supply chain enable competitive pricing and supply stability. The company also focuses on sustainable and innovative solutions such as energy storage, BIPV, and module recycling to provide comprehensive clean energy solutions aligned with global decarbonization goals.
